items.criterion: A transition joined by a declared transition row writes the new status to the datastore.
items.judgment: Read the item row after a transition over the interface and compare its status to the target.

items.criterion: A transition survives a fresh read of the item rather than living on the screen.
items.judgment: Re-read the item over the interface after the move and compare against the stored row.

items.criterion: Each transition appends one history entry, leaving earlier entries as they were.
items.judgment: Count the item's history rows before a move, after a move, then after a second move.

items.criterion: A move between statuses no transition row joins is refused, leaving the stored status alone.
items.judgment: Attempt a move across two non-adjacent statuses and re-read the item row.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous transitions of one item produce a single written move.
items.judgment: Fire two transitions of the same item at once and count the accepted responses plus the history rows.

items.criterion: A notification for a rule-set assignee exists as a real message addressed to that person alone.
items.judgment: Poll the mail server for a message naming the item, then count its recipients.

items.criterion: The notification subject begins with the pinned prefix, then names the item key.
items.judgment: Read the delivered message subject against the pinned prefix literal.

items.criterion: A member of one project is refused another project's items plus its totals.
items.judgment: Call the other project's listing, its summary, then the project list, from that member's session.

items.criterion: A project total equals the number of items the asking person can list.
items.judgment: Compare the summary total against the length of that caller's own listing.

items.criterion: A requester attempting a transition is refused, leaving status plus history untouched.
items.judgment: Attempt the transition from a requester session, then re-read the item row plus its history count.

items.criterion: A shared saved filter resolves the current-user function against the reader.
items.judgment: Run one shared filter from two sessions and compare the returned item sets.

items.criterion: The graduated pricing bands reproduce the pinned worked totals at the pinned team sizes.
items.judgment: Recompute the banded totals at seven users plus three hundred users against the pinned figures.

items.criterion: The console board sits beside a detail pane for the selected work item.
items.judgment: A reader looks at the signed-in board route for two panes rather than one.

items.criterion: The long scrolling story on the home route advances with the scroll offset.
items.judgment: A reader scrolls the home route slowly, then back up, watching the stage.
